clips.title: The story
paras: Around Loch Modan, dwarven defenders need Lurker Venom to counter Dark Iron sabotage. The toxin comes from predatory spiders in the rocky hills and woods.

Lurker Venom helps dwarves disarm Dark Iron explosives. Ashlan Stonesmirk, an explosives expert, named the spiders’ poison as an ingredient for the mixture Chief Engineer Hinderweir prepares. The solvent combines the venom with rare minerals and tears from the loch’s crocolisks, forming a reactive compound that can disarm complex explosives. Lurker spiders range from common wood lurkers to the matriarch Shanda the Spinner, and their bites threaten travelers and mountaineers across the hills and crags.
